sources.name: Fish Passage Center — 7 Day and YTD Adult Counts
Columbia Basin Research DART — Adult Passage Daily

model.basis: Measured on 2026 dam counts, not assumed: Bonneville count surges reappeared at The Dalles about 2 days later and at John Day about 3 days later (detrended daily-count correlation, Aug-Oct 2026 — Chinook r=0.69 at +2 days to The Dalles, r=0.62 at +3 days to John Day; coho peaks at the same lags). 46 miles in ~2 days and 70 miles in ~3 days both work out to ~23 miles/day, inside the published CRITFC inter-dam range for Chinook of 21-42 km/day (13-26 mi/day). Steelhead failed this check (r <= 0.21), so steelhead are counted, never tracked.

note: Counts are the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers' dam counts as published by the Fish Passage Center and Columbia Basin Research DART. Wave positions are estimates from those counts — see the Salmon Tracker card.
